fullSuiteComparison.interpretation: Every author failure name reproduced on baseline. The two variable current/baseline-only cases passed isolated on both commits. This does not establish full-suite or Windows product acceptance; underlying baseline failures remain.

blockingFindings.description: Native descendants/continuations of external delivery lose current collaboration policy authorization. Original mapped job gets dispatch check; continuation executes after policy revocation. Owner confirms lineage exclusion unintended.

New external task admitted while root acceptance awaits capture is acknowledged, but root becomes accepted/PASS from stale pending-task check and delivery fails ORG_ATTEMPT_OBSOLETE without invocation.

Ordinary receive acknowledged durable:true can write above the32MiB reader cap, making valid supervisor impossible to reopen. Synthetic valid453-record seed loaded before final admission; final receipt/reopen use public APIs.

validity: Only exact reviewed commit/source hashes. Re-evaluate after fixes; original failed invariants must be rejected/prevented with independent regression evidence.
